evals.expected_output: Claude dispatches the agent-auditor sub-agent to audit all files in ~/.claude/agents/, presents the full gap report to the user, summarises total agents audited and highest-priority fix, then asks if the user wants to work through High and Medium findings.
assertions: Claude uses the Agent tool to dispatch the agent-auditor
Claude presents the full gap report returned by the agent-auditor
Claude summarises: total agents audited, total findings, highest-priority fix
Claude asks the user whether to proceed with fixing High and Medium findings
Claude does not apply any fixes without user confirmation

evals.expected_output: Claude runs the full audit via the agent-auditor and presents findings. When the user declines to fix, Claude stops — the report is available for manual action.
assertions: Claude stops after presenting the report when the user says no to fixes
Claude does not make any file edits when the user declines

evals.expected_output: Claude dispatches the agent-auditor, presents findings, and when the user says yes to fixing, works through High and Medium findings one at a time — confirming each change before applying to both the installed agent and the playbook repo source file.
assertions: Claude fixes are applied to both ~/.claude/agents/<name>.md and src/claude/agents/<group>/<name>.md
Claude confirms each fix with the user before applying
Claude applies fixes one at a time (not in bulk)
Claude follows the fix_workflow.md sequence for each finding
